ucs.title: [LLM] APT32 (OceanLotus) DLL side-loading via signed third-party binaries from user-writable paths
ucs.description: Hunts for OceanLotus's signature DLL side-loading playbook — legitimate signed binaries from Symantec, McAfee, Avast, Adobe and Office being relocated to %APPDATA%, %TEMP%, %PUBLIC% or other user-writable directories where the actor stages a malicious paired DLL (Denis, KerrDown, COBALT KITTY backdoor loader). Detects the launcher process itself, not the DLL load, because the path-anomaly on the launcher is the highest-fidelity OceanLotus tell.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=t count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Processes.process) as cmdline values(Processes.process_path) as image values(Processes.parent_process_name) as parent values(Processes.process_hash) as sha256 from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.process_name IN ("RasTls.exe","rastls.exe","AcroTranscoder.exe","acrotranscoder.exe","wsc_proxy.exe","mcoemcpy.exe","DTHelper.exe","dthelper.exe","DTLoader.exe","dtloader.exe","oinfo12.exe","SymNeti.exe","symneti.exe","goopdate.exe","GoogleUpdate.exe") by host Processes.user Processes.process_name Processes.process_path Processes.process Processes.parent_process_name Processes.parent_process_path Processes.process_hash | `drop_dm_object_name("Processes")` | rex field=process_path "(?i)^(?<root>[A-Z]:\\\\[^\\\\]+)" | search NOT process_path IN ("*\\Program Files\\*","*\\Program Files (x86)\\*","*\\Windows\\System32\\*","*\\Windows\\SysWOW64\\*","*\\Common Files\\*") | search process_path IN ("*\\AppData\\*","*\\Temp\\*","*\\Users\\Public\\*","*\\ProgramData\\*","*\\Downloads\\*","*\\Music\\*","*\\Pictures\\*","*\\Documents\\*") | `security_content_ctime(firstTime)` | `security_content_ctime(lastTime)` | sort - lastTime
ucs.kql:
let APT32SideloadHosts = dynamic(["rastls.exe","acrotranscoder.exe","wsc_proxy.exe","mcoemcpy.exe","dthelper.exe","dtloader.exe","oinfo12.exe","symneti.exe","goopdate.exe","googleupdate.exe"]);
let ExpectedInstallPaths = dynamic([@"\program files\", @"\program files (x86)\", @"\windows\system32\", @"\windows\syswow64\", @"\common files\"]);
let UserWritablePaths = dynamic([@"\appdata\", @"\temp\", @"\users\public\", @"\programdata\", @"\downloads\", @"\desktop\", @"\documents\", @"\music\", @"\pictures\"]);
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(14d)
| where FileName has_any (APT32SideloadHosts)
| extend lowerPath = tolower(FolderPath)
| where not (lowerPath has_any (ExpectedInstallPaths))
| where lowerPath has_any (UserWritablePaths)
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| join kind=inner (
    DeviceImageLoadEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(14d)
    | where FileName endswith ".dll"
    | project Timestamp, DeviceId, InitiatingProcessId, LoadedDll = FileName, LoadedDllFolder = FolderPath, LoadedDllSHA256 = SHA256
  ) on DeviceId, $left.ProcessId == $right.InitiatingProcessId
| where tolower(LoadedDllFolder) == tolower(FolderPath)   // DLL loaded from same directory as launcher = classic side-load
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, LauncherImage = FolderPath, LauncherSHA256 = SHA256,
          ProcessCommandLine, LoadedDll, LoadedDllSHA256,
          InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessFolderPath, InitiatingProcessCommandLine
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let APT32SideloadHosts = dynamic(["rastls.exe","acrotranscoder.exe","wsc_proxy.exe","mcoemcpy.exe","dthelper.exe","dtloader.exe","oinfo12.exe","symneti.exe","goopdate.exe","googleupdate.exe"]);
let ExpectedInstallPaths = dynamic([@"\program files\", @"\program files (x86)\", @"\windows\system32\", @"\windows\syswow64\", @"\common files\"]);
let UserWritablePaths = dynamic([@"\appdata\", @"\temp\", @"\users\public\", @"\programdata\", @"\downloads\", @"\desktop\", @"\documents\", @"\music\", @"\pictures\"]);
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(14d)
| where EventID == 4688
| extend ImageBase = tolower(tostring(split(NewProcessName, '\\')[-1]))
| where ImageBase in (APT32SideloadHosts)
| extend lowerPath = tolower(NewProcessName)
| where not (lowerPath has_any (ExpectedInstallPaths))
| where lowerPath has_any (UserWritablePaths)
| where SubjectUserName !endswith "$"
| project TimeGenerated, Computer, SubjectUserName, NewProcessName, CommandLine, ParentProcessName, NewProcessId
| order by TimeGenerated desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: APT32 OceanLotus DLL Side-Load Launcher From User-Writable Path
id: 8a3f2b1d-7c4e-4f9a-9c5b-3d2e1f0a4b5c
status: experimental
description: Detects APT32/OceanLotus DLL side-loading by flagging trusted signed launcher binaries (Symantec, McAfee, Avast, Adobe, Google) executing from %APPDATA% / %TEMP% / %PUBLIC% / %PROGRAMDATA% instead of their legitimate install directories.
references:
  - https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0050/
  - https://www.welivesecurity.com/2018/03/13/oceanlotus-ships-new-backdoor/
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/06/12
tags:
  - attack.defense_evasion
  - attack.persistence
  - attack.t1574.002
  - attack.t1036.005
  - attack.g0050
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_img:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\RasTls.exe'
      - '\AcroTranscoder.exe'
      - '\wsc_proxy.exe'
      - '\mcoemcpy.exe'
      - '\DTHelper.exe'
      - '\DTLoader.exe'
      - '\oinfo12.exe'
      - '\SymNeti.exe'
      - '\goopdate.exe'
      - '\GoogleUpdate.exe'
  selection_path:
    Image|contains:
      - '\AppData\'
      - '\Temp\'
      - '\Users\Public\'
      - '\ProgramData\'
      - '\Downloads\'
      - '\Desktop\'
      - '\Documents\'
      - '\Music\'
      - '\Pictures\'
  filter_legit:
    Image|contains:
      - '\Program Files\'
      - '\Program Files (x86)\'
      - '\Windows\System32\'
      - '\Windows\SysWOW64\'
      - '\Common Files\'
  condition: selection_img and selection_path and not filter_legit
falsepositives:
  - Portable/relocated installs of legitimate vendor utilities by IT (rare — IT typically uses MSI install paths)
level: high
ucs.datadog_query: source:(windows.sysmon OR windows.security) (@EventID:1 OR @EventID:4688) (@Image:(*\RasTls.exe OR *\rastls.exe OR *\AcroTranscoder.exe OR *\acrotranscoder.exe OR *\wsc_proxy.exe OR *\mcoemcpy.exe OR *\DTHelper.exe OR *\dthelper.exe OR *\DTLoader.exe OR *\dtloader.exe OR *\oinfo12.exe OR *\SymNeti.exe OR *\symneti.exe OR *\goopdate.exe OR *\GoogleUpdate.exe OR *\googleupdate.exe)) (@Image:(*\AppData\* OR *\appdata\* OR *\Temp\* OR *\temp\* OR *\Users\Public\* OR *\users\public\* OR *\ProgramData\* OR *\programdata\* OR *\Downloads\* OR *\downloads\* OR *\Documents\* OR *\documents\*)) -@Image:(*\Program?Files\* OR *\program?files\* OR *\Windows\System32\* OR *\windows\system32\* OR *\Windows\SysWOW64\* OR *\windows\syswow64\*)
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2
| ImageFileName=/\\(RasTls|AcroTranscoder|wsc_proxy|mcoemcpy|DTHelper|DTLoader|oinfo12|SymNeti|goopdate|GoogleUpdate)\.exe$/i
| regex("\\\\(AppData|Temp|Users\\\\Public|ProgramData|Downloads|Desktop|Documents|Music|Pictures)\\\\", field=ImageFileName)
| NOT regex("\\\\(Program Files|Program Files \\(x86\\)|Windows\\\\System32|Windows\\\\SysWOW64|Common Files)\\\\", field=ImageFileName)
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName, ImageFileName, ParentBaseFileName, SHA256HashData], function=[count(), min(@timestamp, as=firstSeen), max(@timestamp, as=lastSeen)])
| sort(lastSeen, order=desc)

ucs.title: [LLM] APT32 (OceanLotus) maldoc-driven KerrDown loader: Office spawning PowerShell with base64 shellcode + reflective allocation
ucs.description: Catches OceanLotus's KerrDown / Denis / Salgorea PowerShell loader stage, where weaponised Vietnamese/SE-Asia-themed Word documents spawn powershell.exe with a long base64 blob plus signature reflective-injection cmdlets ([Reflection.Assembly], VirtualAlloc, CreateThread, Convert::FromBase64String). This chain is documented across Palo Alto Unit 42 (KerrDown), ESET (OceanLotus Denis), and Cybereason (Cobalt Kitty), and is the dominant APT32 initial-access execution path for targeted Vietnamese-dissident, ASEAN-government, and automotive/manufacturing victims.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=t count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Processes.process) as cmdline values(Processes.process_hash) as sha256 values(Processes.parent_process) as parent_cmdline from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.parent_process_name IN ("winword.exe","excel.exe","powerpnt.exe","outlook.exe") Processes.process_name IN ("powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","cmd.exe","rundll32.exe","mshta.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe") by host Processes.user Processes.process_name Processes.parent_process_name Processes.process Processes.parent_process | `drop_dm_object_name("Processes")` | where match(process,"(?i)(FromBase64String|Reflection\.Assembly|VirtualAlloc|CreateThread|Invoke-Expression|IEX|-enc(odedcommand)?\b|-w(indowstyle)?\s+h(idden)?|DownloadString|DownloadData|Net\.WebClient|kerrdown|salgorea)") OR len(process) > 600 | `security_content_ctime(firstTime)` | `security_content_ctime(lastTime)` | sort - lastTime
ucs.kql:
let OfficeParents = dynamic(["winword.exe","excel.exe","powerpnt.exe","outlook.exe","eqnedt32.exe"]);
let SuspiciousChildren = dynamic(["powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","cmd.exe","rundll32.exe","mshta.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe","regsvr32.exe"]);
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(14d)
| where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ (OfficeParents)
| where FileName in~ (SuspiciousChildren)
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| extend cmd = tolower(ProcessCommandLine)
| where cmd has_any ("frombase64string","reflection.assembly","virtualalloc","createthread","invoke-expression","iex","-enc","-ec ","-encodedcommand","-w hidden","-windowstyle hidden","downloadstring","downloaddata","net.webclient","kerrdown","salgorea")
   or strlen(ProcessCommandLine) > 600
| extend B64 = extract(@"(?i)(?:-(?:e(?:nc(?:odedcommand)?)?))\s+([A-Za-z0-9+/=]{40,})", 1, ProcessCommandLine)
| extend Decoded = iff(isnotempty(B64), base64_decode_tostring(B64), "")
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName,
          ParentImage = InitiatingProcessFolderPath,
          ParentCmd = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
          ChildImage = FolderPath,
          ChildCmd = ProcessCommandLine,
          CmdLen = strlen(ProcessCommandLine),
          B64, Decoded, SHA256
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let OfficeParents = dynamic(["winword.exe","excel.exe","powerpnt.exe","outlook.exe","eqnedt32.exe"]);
let SuspiciousChildren = dynamic(["powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","cmd.exe","rundll32.exe","mshta.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe","regsvr32.exe"]);
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(14d)
| where EventID == 4688
| extend ParentBase = tolower(tostring(split(ParentProcessName, '\\')[-1]))
| extend ChildBase = tolower(tostring(split(NewProcessName, '\\')[-1]))
| where ParentBase in (OfficeParents)
| where ChildBase in (SuspiciousChildren)
| where SubjectUserName !endswith "$"
| extend cmd = tolower(CommandLine)
| where cmd has_any ("frombase64string","reflection.assembly","virtualalloc","createthread","invoke-expression","iex","-enc","-ec ","-encodedcommand","-w hidden","-windowstyle hidden","downloadstring","downloaddata","net.webclient","kerrdown","salgorea")
   or strlen(CommandLine) > 600
| project TimeGenerated, Computer, SubjectUserName, ParentProcessName, NewProcessName, CommandLine, CmdLen = strlen(CommandLine)
| order by TimeGenerated desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: APT32 OceanLotus KerrDown Loader - Office Spawning Obfuscated PowerShell
id: 4b7e9c2a-1d8f-4a5e-bf3c-6e2a9d1c4f8b
status: experimental
description: Detects APT32/OceanLotus KerrDown/Denis/Salgorea loader execution where a weaponised Office document spawns PowerShell or another script host with reflective-injection cmdlets, base64 payloads, or hidden-window flags.
references:
  - https://unit42.paloaltonetworks.com/tracking-oceanlotus-new-downloader-kerrdown/
  - https://www.welivesecurity.com/2018/03/13/oceanlotus-ships-new-backdoor/
  - https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0050/
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/06/12
tags:
  - attack.execution
  - attack.t1059.001
  - attack.t1204.002
  - attack.t1055.001
  - attack.g0050
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  parent_office:
    ParentImage|endswith:
      - '\winword.exe'
      - '\excel.exe'
      - '\powerpnt.exe'
      - '\outlook.exe'
      - '\eqnedt32.exe'
  child_script_host:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\powershell.exe'
      - '\pwsh.exe'
      - '\cmd.exe'
      - '\rundll32.exe'
      - '\mshta.exe'
      - '\wscript.exe'
      - '\cscript.exe'
      - '\regsvr32.exe'
  cmdline_markers:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'FromBase64String'
      - 'Reflection.Assembly'
      - 'VirtualAlloc'
      - 'CreateThread'
      - 'Invoke-Expression'
      - 'IEX'
      - '-enc'
      - '-EncodedCommand'
      - '-w hidden'
      - '-WindowStyle Hidden'
      - 'DownloadString'
      - 'DownloadData'
      - 'Net.WebClient'
  condition: parent_office and child_script_host and cmdline_markers
falsepositives:
  - Macro-enabled enterprise templates that legitimately call PowerShell (very rare; whitelist by publisher hash)
level: high
ucs.datadog_query: source:(windows.sysmon OR windows.security) (@EventID:1 OR @EventID:4688) @ParentImage:(*\winword.exe OR *\WINWORD.EXE OR *\excel.exe OR *\EXCEL.EXE OR *\powerpnt.exe OR *\POWERPNT.EXE OR *\outlook.exe OR *\OUTLOOK.EXE OR *\eqnedt32.exe OR *\EQNEDT32.EXE) @Image:(*\powershell.exe OR *\PowerShell.exe OR *\POWERSHELL.EXE OR *\pwsh.exe OR *\cmd.exe OR *\CMD.EXE OR *\rundll32.exe OR *\RUNDLL32.EXE OR *\mshta.exe OR *\MSHTA.EXE OR *\wscript.exe OR *\WSCRIPT.EXE OR *\cscript.exe OR *\regsvr32.exe) @CommandLine:(*FromBase64String* OR *frombase64string* OR *Reflection.Assembly* OR *reflection.assembly* OR *VirtualAlloc* OR *virtualalloc* OR *CreateThread* OR *createthread* OR *Invoke-Expression* OR *invoke-expression* OR *-enc* OR *-EncodedCommand* OR *-encodedcommand* OR *DownloadString* OR *downloadstring* OR *Net.WebClient* OR *net.webclient* OR *-w?hidden* OR *-WindowStyle?Hidden*)
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2
| ParentBaseFileName=/^(winword|excel|powerpnt|outlook|eqnedt32)\.exe$/i
| ImageFileName=/\\(powershell|pwsh|cmd|rundll32|mshta|wscript|cscript|regsvr32)\.exe$/i
| regex("(?i)(FromBase64String|Reflection\\.Assembly|VirtualAlloc|CreateThread|Invoke-Expression|\\bIEX\\b|-enc(odedcommand)?\\b|-w(indowstyle)?\\s+h(idden)?|DownloadString|DownloadData|Net\\.WebClient|kerrdown|salgorea)", field=CommandLine)
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName, ParentBaseFileName, ImageFileName, CommandLine], function=[count(), min(@timestamp, as=firstSeen), max(@timestamp, as=lastSeen)])
| sort(lastSeen, order=desc)
ucs.rationale: Office-app → script-host with reflective-injection cmdlets is the published signature of OceanLotus's KerrDown loader (Unit 42, 2019) and its older Denis/Salgorea relatives (ESET, 2018). While other actors use Office macros, APT32's chain is distinguished by the combination of base64-blob + reflective .NET allocation + hidden window in a single command line — a fingerprint that survives obfuscatio
